title: Warm Spicy Mediterranean Fregola Pilaf
description: A spicy and flavorful Mediterranean dish featuring fregola, perfect for a date night, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients and a burst of pickle flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped red onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the toasted fregola and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chopped pickle and cherry tomatoes, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10-12 minutes, until the fregola is tender.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
